review.note: Reviewed every direct build, runtime, dev and Node candidate, including outside declared upper bounds. This breaking compatibility lane requires Core >=0.43.0,<0.44.0 and schema 9; registry Core 0.42.2 is deliberately excluded because it retains schema 8. The explicitly supplied non-editable working Core 0.43.0 wheel SHA256 00f8f4a7f7f1ef03a114a5ff35d3783b946f9225cb376647f8e251ddd068e665 was installed and verified. Schema 9 replaces global GID upload time with immutable observation and publication occurrence times; the public CatalogPublication fields and reader facade contract remain unchanged. Komga consumes published_at through its existing neutral translation and public read-only readiness/catalog facades; it has no schema internals or compatibility shim. Updated real SQLite readiness tests accept exact schema 9, reject previous/future/BUILDING markers without mutation, and prevent startup full audits. Updated declared/installed dependency and installed-wheel SQLite smoke boundaries. All 119 offline tests and the fast gate passed with this candidate, including metadata mapping, revision fencing and read-only admission. External registry candidates and installed versions are unchanged from the reviewed 2026-09-25 receipt: Hatchling 1.32.4, requests 2.34.2, build 1.6.1, Ruff 0.16.9, mypy 2.3.1, packaging 26.3, pytest 9.1.1 and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3; their prior official release-note review remains in Git history. Core active runtime requirements passed installed dependency consistency. The final Core wheel, exact final consumer gate and installed-wheel smoke are separate required validation, not claimed by this candidate receipt. No live Komga, account, NAS or production database was used.
